g.text: UML sequence — Outgoing external payment, holds and uncertain outcomes (proposed)
Confirm quote + beneficiary + amount + step-up + idempotency key
Denial via channel; no payment side effect
Get/create instruction by scoped key and fingerprint
Conflict via channel; no new instruction
Current entitlement, approval, limits, screening and fraud gates
No provider submission; review must revalidate gates before continuation.
Atomic restriction/availability check + hold + business key
FUNDS_RESERVED; then durable submission intent / SUBMITTING
Submit with stable provider key / reference
Inquire with original identity; do not blindly resubmit.
No automatic hold release while execution is uncertain.
Accepted is not settled; customer sees pending.
Match reference, amount, currency and finality policy
Atomic balanced batch + consume hold + outbox
[Core committed or prior equivalent result found]
Query/retry same business posting key; never create a second posting.
Actual state, dates, fees and permitted actions via channel
FR-PAY-01-09; AT-06-11. Internal transfers instead post both customer accounts atomically with no external provider.
